title: APL feed document with touch to open a story
description: skill-package APL document for the feed: a Sequence of story cards (image, headline, dek), site theme colours and fonts, and a TouchWrapper that sends a UserEvent to open the story. The handler handles Alexa.Presentation.APL.UserEvent. Gherkin covers the directive contents and the touch event.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: the APL feed with touch, in AnthusAI/Papyrus#944, wired to speech in AnthusAI/Papyrus#950. It renders in the developer console simulator.
